important_note: This is not a government internal approval dataset. It is a desensitized demonstration dataset derived from public notices and official policy texts.
case_id_method: Synthetic sequential IDs by source/policy group, e.g. BJ-AIV25-DEMAND-001. The package does not contain raw company names, so IDs are not reversible.

label_definitions.public_notice_qualified: Entity/project appeared in a public qualification-review notice or public qualification-result attachment.
label_definitions.public_notice_candidate: Entity appeared in a public拟入库/candidate list; not the same as final inclusion.
label_definitions.public_notice_final_included: Entity appeared in a public final入库/inclusion announcement after objection period.
label_definitions.public_notice_not_included_after_objecti: Aggregate negative label inferred from official announcement that some拟入库 entities were removed after objection verification; no raw identity or failure reason is stored.

recommended_use: Demonstrate data sourcing and outcome-label design.
Calibrate product language: readiness score, not official approval probability.
Build evaluation samples for retrieval and rule consistency.
Do not train a high-stakes approval prediction model without authorized application-level data.
